audit.why: Both layers already read Kennen, Skill, Skill, Kennen, Gwen, Gwen, Kennen, which is exactly what the mirror set on Gwen's side. The packet differs at rows 1 and 5, but the mirror is the binding constraint and the prose supports it: level 2-3 is a genuine skill window once Skip 'n Slash arrives, and first item is hers while the mist is up on cooldown.
audit.corrected: No chart edits — the two directions agree as they stand.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page treats Hallowed Mist as a level-6 spike — 'she has no mist until 6' in early, and the Lvl 6 spike is written as the mist arriving.
audit.why: Hallowed Mist is Gwen's W, available from level 2 on a 22/21/20/19/18s cooldown. Her level-6 spike is Needlework (R), 120/100/80s at 1200 range with three casts. Telling a player the mist cannot exist before 6 will get them killed at level 3 by a Gwen who took a point in it.
audit.corrected: early rewritten to say she rarely spends an early point on it rather than that it does not exist; the 22s cooldown written into breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two problems. Slicing Maelstrom is called a channel in spikes[1] and wants.foe[0]; and the mist is written as a flat 'she is untargetable', with no mention of the way through it.
audit.why: Riot's text for Hallowed Mist is 'She can only be targeted by enemies who enter the mist' — it is conditional, not absolute, and Kennen's Lightning Rush (170 range, 10/9/8/7/6s) passes through units to get in. That is the single most actionable fact in the matchup and the page never states it. Slicing Maelstrom, meanwhile, is not a channel — Riot's text is 'summons a storm that strikes at nearby enemy champions' and the kit carries only a zone flag.
audit.corrected: whys[4], spikes[1].text, mid and wants.foe[0] now state that stepping into the cloud restores targeting, and the channel wording is gone.

audit.whatIsWrong: The cooldown block gave no numbers and Skip 'n Slash was never treated as a cooldown at all.
audit.why: Skip 'n Slash is 13/12.5/12/11.5/11s but 'if she hits an enemy during that time, this Ability's cooldown is partially refunded' — so it is effectively far shorter in a trade she is winning. Hallowed Mist at 22s is the real punishable window.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns rebuilt with the 22s mist, the 13s refunding dash and the flat 120s R.

audit.why: A Thousand Cuts heals her off champion damage, so the needs-antiheal flag applies and report[8].t already lists Oblivion Orb / Executioner's early.

edits.before: Her spike, not yours: Hallowed Mist makes her untargetable, so she W's your Slicing Maelstrom and your whole stun-lock whiffs.
edits.after: Her spike, not yours: Hallowed Mist blocks you from outside the cloud, so unless you step in with her, your whole stun-lock whiffs.

edits.before: Gwen's spike, not yours: Hallowed Mist goes untargetable, so the moment you channel Slicing Maelstrom she W's into the cloud and your storm hits nothing.
edits.after: Gwen's spike, not yours: Hallowed Mist blocks targeting from outside, so she W's as your storm lands — step into the cloud with her or it hits nothing.

edits.before: Drop Hallowed Mist the instant you channel R so the storm and your marks whiff
edits.after: Drop Hallowed Mist as your R lands so the storm and your marks whiff from outside

edits.before: Gwen's range is short and she has no mist until 6, so levels 1-3 are yours to bully. Land Q (Thundering Shuriken) on her approach to stack Mark of the Storm, and at level 2-3 weave Electrical Surge autos in to pop the third-stack stun before she can E-dash away. Don't dump everything chasing her through minions where Snip Snip (Q) out-trades a whiff — chip, stun, and back off. She has no answer to a clean two-spell mark stun this early.
edits.after: Gwen's range is short and she rarely spends an early point on the mist, so levels 1-3 are yours to bully. Land Q (Thundering Shuriken) on her approach to stack Mark of the Storm, and at level 2-3 weave Electrical Surge autos in to pop the third-stack stun before she can E-dash away. Don't dump everything chasing her through minions where Snip Snip (Q) out-trades a whiff — chip, stun, back off. If she does take W, it is 22 seconds.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 stay a poke edge — keep marking her with Q and W and respect her E reset if she dashes in. The trap is 6: the second she has Hallowed Mist, your Slicing Maelstrom stops being a guaranteed stun-lock because she W's untargetable and your storm strikes nothing. Bait the mist or all-in BEFORE she drops it — Q-W-E-Flash-R only lands the full stun if she's not standing in the cloud. If the mist is up, hold your R.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 stay a poke edge — keep marking her with Q and W and respect her E reset if she dashes in. The trap is the mist: she can only be hit by enemies standing inside it, so a Gwen who W's mid-combo blanks your storm unless you Lightning Rush in after her. Bait the 22s mist or all-in before she drops it — Q-W-E-Flash-R only lands the full stun if you are in the cloud with her.

edits.before: - Gwen Hallowed Mist: matchup-defining — She’s safe inside. Poke when down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Gwen Hallowed Mist: matchup-defining — 22s at rank 1; only enemies inside can hit her, so E in after her or wait it out. - Skip 'n Slash (13s, refunded on hit): her dash. - Your R: flat 120s, kill windows only.

notes: The chart was already mirror-consistent, so no rows were touched. Two packet suspectNames ('Snip Snip', 'Hallowed Mist's') are false positives — both names are correct, the flags fired on the possessive and the missing exclamation mark. The genuine defects were treating Hallowed Mist as a level-6 unlock and never telling the player they can walk into the mist to regain targeting.
